40016101.author: पदार्थः
40016101.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa's Lord, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता very, क्रोधेन by anger, आविष्टः overcome, उरगोयथा like a serpent, निश्श्वसन् hissing, दीर्घम् deep, उष्णम् hot, विनिश्श्वस्य heaving a burning sigh, क्रोधेन in anger, कलुषीकृतः having done a dirty task, क्रूरम् cruel, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016101.author: Translation
40016101.content: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowess.

40016102.author: पदार्थः
40016102.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa's Lord, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता very, क्रोधेन by anger, आविष्टः overcome, उरगोयथा like a serpent, निश्श्वसन् hissing, दीर्घम् deep, उष्णम् hot, विनिश्श्वस्य heaving a burning sigh, क्रोधेन in anger, कलुषीकृतः having done a dirty task, क्रूरम् cruel, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016102.author: Translation
40016102.content: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowess.

40016102.author: सारांशः
40016102.content: Ravana sends Vajradamshtra to fight. Fierce fight takes place between Vanaras and Vajradamshtra.

40016103.author: पदार्थः
40016103.content: वीर hero, त्वम् you, गच्छ proceed, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परिवारितः accompanied by companions, निर्याहि kill, दाशरथिम् Dasaratha's, रामम् Rama, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, वानरैः Vanaras सह along with, जहि ongoing.

40016103.author: Translation
40016103.content: "O Hero, proceed, accompanied by Rakshasa companions and kill Dasaratha's Rama and Sugriva along with Vanaras."

40016104.author: पदार्थः
40016104.content: मायावी deceit, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, तथाइति in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, बलैःसार्थम् along with army, बहुभिः many, परिवारितः generals, नागैः elephants, अश्वैः horses, खरैः donkeys, उष्ट्रैः camels, पताकाध्वचित्रैः banners and pennons, रथैः chariots, संयुक्तः collected, सुसमाहितः collected, समलङ्कृतः decorated, द्रुततरम् armlets and diadems, निर्जगाम went.

40016104.author: Translation
40016104.content: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

40016105.author: पदार्थः
40016105.content: मायावी deceit, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, तथाइति in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, बलैःसार्थम् along with army, बहुभिः many, परिवारितः generals, नागैः elephants, अश्वैः horses, खरैः donkeys, उष्ट्रैः camels, पताकाध्वचित्रैः banners and pennons, रथैः chariots, संयुक्तः collected, सुसमाहितः collected, समलङ्कृतः decorated, द्रुततरम् armlets and diadems, निर्जगाम went.

40016105.author: Translation
40016105.content: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

40016106.author: पदार्थः
40016106.content: ततः thereafter, विचित्रकेयूरमुकुटेन adorned with wonderful crown studded with keyura gems विभूषितः decorated, तनुत्राणिच co at covering the body, समावृत्य wearing, सधनुः with a bow, द्रुतम् alert, निर्वयौ went forward.

40016106.author: Translation
40016106.content: Thereafter adorned with wonderful crowns studded with keyura gems, wearing a co at covering the body with bow in hand went alert.

40016107.author: पदार्थः
40016107.content: चमूपतिः general, पताकालङ्कृतम् decorated with flags, दीप्तम् glowing, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषितम् shining in polished gold, रथम् chariot, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round clockwise, समारोहत् ascended.

40016107.author: Translation
40016107.content: The general went ascending the chariot shining with well polished shining gold, decked with flags after going around clockwise.

40016108.author: पदार्थः
40016108.content: शस्त्रपाणयः armed with swords, विविधाः many, पदातयश्च foot soldiers, यष्टभिः poles, चित्रैः strange, तोमरैः iron clubs, शूलैश्च tridents, मुसलैरपि iron bars, भिदनिपालैश्च slings used to throw, पाशैश्च ropes, शक्तिभिः spears, पट्टसैरपि spears with sharp edge, खडगैः swords, चक्रैः javelins, गदाभिश्च maces, निशितैः sharp, परश्वधैः battle axes, निर्यान्ति departed.

40016108.author: Translation
40016108.content: Armed with swords, many foot soldiers carrying poles, strange clubs, tridents, iron bars, slings and roped to throw spears and spears with sharp edges, swords, battle axes, javelins, and maces, departed.

40016109.author: पदार्थः
40016109.content: शस्त्रपाणयः armed with swords, विविधाः many, पदातयश्च foot soldiers, यष्टभिः poles, चित्रैः strange, तोमरैः iron clubs, शूलैश्च tridents, मुसलैरपि iron bars, भिदनिपालैश्च slings used to throw, पाशैश्च ropes, शक्तिभिः spears, पट्टसैरपि spears with sharp edge, खडगैः swords, चक्रैः javelins, गदाभिश्च maces, निशितैः sharp, परश्वधैः battle axes, निर्यान्ति departed.

40016109.author: Translation
40016109.content: Armed with swords, many foot soldiers carrying poles, strange clubs, tridents, iron bars, slings and roped to throw spears and spears with sharp edges, swords, battle axes, javelins, and maces, departed.

40016110.author: पदार्थः
40016110.content: विचित्रवाससः decorated with lovely raiment, सर्वे all, दीप्ताः glowing, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः Rakshasa leaders, शूराः heroes, चलन्तः moved, पर्वताःइव like mountains, मदोत्कटाः intoxicated with ichor, गजाः elephants.

40016110.author: Translation
40016110.content: All the Rakshasa leaders decorated with lovely raiment, glowing, the heroes moved like mountains. They seemed like elephants intoxicated with ichor.

40016111.author: पदार्थः
40016111.content: तोमराङ्कुशपाणिभिः carrying tridents and clubs, रूढाः goads, ते they, युद्धकुशलैः eager for war, शूरारूढाः mounted, लक्षणसंयुक्ताः noble characteristics, अन्ये others, महाबलाः extraordinary might.

40016111.author: Translation
40016111.content: Carrying tridents, clubs, and goads eager for war the Rakshasas mounted on mahouts and horses of noble characteristics, warriors with extraordinary might departed.

40016112.author: पदार्थः
40016112.content: विप्रस्थितम् determined with purpose, तत् then, सर्वम् entire, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, प्रावृट् काले rainy season, नर्दमानाः roaring, सविद्युतः in the vicinity, मेघाःयथा like cloud, यथा like that, अशोभत splendid, यत्र there, अङ्गदः Angada, यूथपः army, दक्षिणद्वारात् from southern gate, निःसृता crossing over.

40016112.author: Translation
40016112.content: Then the entire Rakshasa army determined with a purpose roaring like clouds of the rainy season it looked splendid and crossed over the southern gate where Angada was stationed.

40016113.author: पदार्थः
40016113.content: तेषाम् in that way, निष्क्रममाणानाम् as they were leaving, अशुभम् evil, अजायत portents, विघनात् appeared, तीव्रात् intense, आकाशात् from the sky, तदा then, उल्काश्च meteors, अभ्यपतन् falling, घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः dazzling fire, वमन्तःववाशिरे giving out from the sky.

40016113.author: Translation
40016113.content: As they were leaving evil portents appeared. Dreadful jackals, dazzling fire from the sky and meteors falling appeared.

40016114.author: पदार्थः
40016114.content: तेषाम् in that way, निष्क्रममाणानाम् as they were leaving, अशुभम् evil, अजायत portents, विघनात् appeared, तीव्रात् intense, आकाशात् from the sky, तदा then, उल्काश्च meteors, अभ्यपतन् falling, घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः dazzling fire, वमन्तःववाशिरे giving out from the sky.

40016114.author: Translation
40016114.content: As they were leaving evil portents appeared. Dreadful jackals, dazzling fire from the sky and meteors falling appeared.

40016115.author: पदार्थः
40016115.content: तदा then, घोराः fierce, मृगाः animals, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, निधनम् indicated, व्याहरन्त destruction, समापतन्तः fell down, योधास्तु in war, तत्र there, दारुणम् dreadful, प्रास्खलन् while going.

40016115.author: Translation
40016115.content: Then the fierce animals indicated the death of Rakshasas, who were going deluded with war and fell down.

40016116.author: पदार्थः
40016116.content: महाबलः mighty, तेजस्वी energetic, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, एतान् , औत्पातिकान् portents that came out, दृष्टवा seeing, धैर्यम् courageous, आलम्भ्य picking up, रणोत्सुकः eager for war, निर्जगाम sallied forth.

40016116.author: Translation
40016116.content: Mighty Vajradamshtra who was energetic, picking up courage seeing the portents that came up, sallied forth eager for war.

40016117.author: पदार्थः
40016117.content: जितकाशिनः who assumed victory, वानराः Vanaras, निष्क्रमतः coming out, तान् them, दृष्टवा seeing, सुमहानादान् loud noise, प्रणेदुः stretching, दश ten, दिशः directions, पूरयंश्च filled.

40016117.author: Translation
40016117.content: Vanaras who assumed victory, seeing the Rakshasas coming out stretching filled all the ten directions with loud noise.

40016118.author: पदार्थः
40016118.content: ततः then, घोराणाम् dreadful, भीमरूपाणाम् fierce form, अन्योन्यवथकाङ् क्षिणाम् each one trying to kill another, हरीणाम् Vanaras, तथा in the same way, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तुमुलम् intense, प्रवृत्तम् encounter.

40016118.author: Translation
40016118.content: Then dreadful encounters of fierce form took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas each one trying to kill another.

40016119.author: पदार्थः
40016119.content: निष्पतन्तः proceeding, महोत्साहाः very eager, भिन्नदेहशिरोधराः bodies broken heads severed, रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गाः all limbs bathed in blood, धरणीतले on the ground, न्यपतन् fell.

40016119.author: Translation
40016119.content: Proceeding Further, very eager to fight they fell on the ground with their bodies broken, heads severed, and all limbs bathed in blood.

40016120.author: पदार्थः
40016120.content: परिघपाणयः whose hand s resembled iron clubs, शूराः heroes, समरेषु in war, अनिवर्तिनः who never turned back, केचित् indeed, अन्योन्यम् one another, आसाद्य, विविधं many kinds, शस्त्रम् weapons, चिक्षिपुः flung.

40016120.author: Translation
40016120.content: Heroes in war whose hand s were like iron clubs, who never turned back in war, indeed flung weapons of many kinds on one another.

40016121.author: पदार्थः
40016121.content: तत्र there, द्रुमाणांशिलानांच trees and rocks, शस्त्राणांच weapons also, घोरः fierce, हृदयभेदसः pierced hearts, सुमहान् loud, निःस्वनः in the battlefield, श्रूयते heard.

40016121.author: Translation
40016121.content: There, a very loud fearful noise was heard which pierced the hearts in the battlefield, that was produced by the striking of weapons with trees and rocks.

40016122.author: पदार्थः
40016122.content: तत्र there, निस्वसत् came out, रथनेमिस्वनः clutter of chariots, धनुषश्चापि and bows, शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानाम् conch, and kettle drums, and tom toms तुमुलः tumultuous, स्वनः sound, बभूव heard.

40016122.author: Translation
40016122.content: Then came out tumultuous sounds of clutter of chariots, bows, conches, kettle drums and tom toms.

40016123.author: पदार्थः
40016123.content: केचित् indeed, अस्त्राणि weapons, सन्सृज्य abandoning, युद्धम् battle, अकुर्वत not did, तलैश्च palms, चरणैश्चापि feet, मुष्टिभिश्च fists, द्रुमैरपि trees, जानुभिश्च knees, युद्धदुर्मदैः, वानरैः Vanaras, हताः smashed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, केचित् indeed, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णिताः crushed.

40016123.author: Translation
40016123.content: Indeed, abandoning the weapons, the Vanaras fought with their palms, fists, feet, trees, and knees and smashed the Rakshasas crushing their bodies like rocks.

40016124.author: पदार्थः
40016124.content: केचित् indeed, अस्त्राणि weapons, सन्सृज्य abandoning, युद्धम् battle, अकुर्वत not did, तलैश्च palms, चरणैश्चापि feet, मुष्टिभिश्च fists, द्रुमैरपि trees, जानुभिश्च knees, युद्धदुर्मदैः, वानरैः Vanaras, हताः smashed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, केचित् indeed, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णिताः crushed.

40016124.author: Translation
40016124.content: Indeed, abandoning the weapons, the Vanaras fought with their palms, fists, feet, trees, and knees and smashed the Rakshasas crushing their bodies like rocks.

40016125.author: पदार्थः
40016125.content: वज्रदंष्ट्रैः Vajradamshtra, रणे in battle, बाणैः with arrows, हरीन् at Vanaras, भृशम् striking, वित्रासयन् destruction, लोकसंहारे destruction of the world, पाशहस्तः with noose in hand, अन्तकःइव like god of death, चचार went about.

40016125.author: Translation
40016125.content: Vajradamshtra went about in the battle striking Vanaras just like death goes with a noose for destruction of the world.

40016126.author: पदार्थः
40016126.content: बलवन्तः mighty, अस्त्रविदुषः endowed with skill of weapons, नानाप्रहरणाः of every kind, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, क्रोधमूर्छिताः deluded with anger, रणे in war, वानरसैन्यानि at the Vanara army, जघ्नुः went.

40016126.author: Translation
40016126.content: Mighty Vajradamshtra, who was endowed with the skill of using every kind of weapon, deluded with anger, went after the Vanara army.

40016127.author: पदार्थः
40016127.content: दृष्टवाः seeing, वालिसुतः Vali's son, क्रोधेन enraged, द्विगुणाविष्टः redoubled, संवर्तके at the time of universal destruction, अनलःइव like fire, रणे in war, तान् them, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, निघ्नतः exterminate.

40016127.author: Translation
40016127.content: Seeing the Vanaras being destroyed, Vali's son, Angada with redoubled anger, like fire at the time of universal destruction, started to exterminate Rakshasas.

40016128.author: पदार्थः
40016128.content: वीर्यवान् heroic, अङ्गदः Angada, क्रोथताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, वृक्षम् tree, उद्यम्य seizing, सिंहः like lion, क्षुद्रमृगानिव like a lion with small animals, सर्वान् all, तान् of them, राक्षसगणान् Rakshasa army, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः equal to Indra in prowess, घोरम् fierce, कदनम् fierce fight, चकार made.

40016128.author: Translation
40016128.content: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.

40016129.author: पदार्थः
40016129.content: वीर्यवान् heroic, अङ्गदः Angada, क्रोथताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, वृक्षम् tree, उद्यम्य seizing, सिंहः like lion, क्षुद्रमृगानिव like a lion with small animals, सर्वान् all, तान् of them, राक्षसगणान् Rakshasa army, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः equal to Indra in prowess, घोरम् fierce, कदनम् fierce fight, चकार made.

40016129.author: Translation
40016129.content: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.

40016130.author: पदार्थः
40016130.content: तत्र there, अङ्गदाभिहताः struck by Angada, भीमविक्रमाः of fearful valour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विभिन्नशिरसः with broken heads, विकृताः smashed, पादपाःइव like trees, पेतुः fell.

40016130.author: Translation
40016130.content: There, struck by Angada of fearful valour, the Rakshasas fell like trees smashed and heads broken.

40016131.author: पदार्थः
40016131.content: तदा then, रथैः chariots, चित्रैः wonderful, ध्वजैः flags, अश्वैः horses, हरिरक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, शरीरैः bodies, रुधिरेण in blood, सञ्छन्ना bathed, भूमिः ground, भयकरा fearful to look.

40016131.author: Translation
40016131.content: Then the wonderful chariots, flags, horses, Vanaras and Rakshasas bodies bathed in blood fell on the ground looked fearful.

40016132.author: पदार्थः
40016132.content: हारकेयूरवस्त्रश्च with strewn armlets, necklaces, clothes, शत्रैश्च weapons, तत्र there, रणे in the battlefield, समलङ्कृता decorated all over, भूमिः ground, शारदी night, निशेवयथा like autumnal night, भाति shone.

40016132.author: Translation
40016132.content: The battlefield with strewn armlets, necklaces and clothes, weapons looked like autumnal night decorated all over.
